description.value: Yummy Donair & Kebab is a fast-casual restaurant in North Vancouver specializing in Middle Eastern and Persian-inspired cuisine, including donairs, kebabs, and falafel. Opened in 2011, the restaurant developed its own spice blends and cooking processes around a healthier take on traditional kebabs. Online ordering and catering services are available, making it a practical stop for a quick hot meal.
